_doc: Street look (render/roads): strip colours (sRGB), heights over the carriageway (m), junction corners, dropped kerbs, markings and how the street furniture looks; where the furniture stands and where the crosswalk and stop line lie is data/catalog/street_furniture.json. markings follow CONTRAN's Manual Brasileiro de Sinalização de Trânsito, vol. IV, Sinalização Horizontal (2007): white N 9.5 and yellow 10YR 7.5/14 Munsell, as sRGB through the Munsell renotation data (RIT real.dat; Y by ASTM D1535; illuminant C to D65 by Bradford); longitudinal lines 0.10 m below 80 km/h and 0.15 m from it, an exclusive lane's line 0.25 m (its 0.20 to 0.30 m), double lines 0.10 m apart; dashes by speed, the first pattern its tables give for each band (below 60 km/h 2 m dash, 4 m gap; to 80, 3 and 6; beyond, 3 and 9); zebra bars 0.35 m wide 0.55 m apart, the middle of its 0.30 to 0.40 and 0.30 to 0.80 m, as many as fit across the carriageway and centred on it. Heights: kerb, sidewalk and median 0.15 m over the carriageway (Porto Velho LC 748/2018 and the São Paulo standard kerb: 15 cm over the grade; the sidewalk level with the kerb's top), barrier 0.81 m (FHWA: the 32 in New Jersey safety shape). Dropped kerbs (ABNT NBR 9050): no lip at the road (low_m 0), the ramp across the footway and its far wing at most 1:12, 1.80 m for a 0.15 m kerb (run_m, flare_m); the wing on the junction side (full_m), where the ramp starts and ends along the kerb (flat_m) and the narrowest footway that gets one (min_walk_m) are not yet sized from the crosswalk (data/catalog/street_furniture.json crossing): the norm wants 1.20 m left free behind the ramp, else the whole footway lowered with 1:20 ramps along it.

props._doc: Parts in local metres (+z faces the road or the arriving traffic, base at y = 0). shape box (min, max), cylinder (base, radius, height, segments) or blob (center, radius); glow 'night' lights the part at night. Signal lenses: lens 0/1/2 = the cars' red/amber/green (on both faces of the head), 3/4 = the walkers' stop/walk (their head faces -x, across the crosswalk; the cars' red and green). color is the lens lit as the screen shows it (render/tone_map.gd gives the radiance): the colour regions of road traffic signals (CIE, as tabled by Janoff, Transportation Research Record 1316, 1991, Table 1; EN 12368 Table 7 asks the same) lie outside what an sRGB screen shows for red and amber, so each is the brightest colour the Environment's ACES can show whose chromaticity is within one MacAdam step (0.0011 in CIE 1976 u'v', CIE TN 001:2014) of the nearest one it can show (red: 0.0377 from the region, the nearest 0.0366; amber: 0.0073, the nearest 0.0062); green the brightest inside its region. An unlit lens is that colour times lens_dim (sRGB), a dark filter lit by the scene: in full sun (daylight.json sun and ambient) it stays at least 16 times dimmer than the lens lit, the phantom signal class 5 of EN 12368 (ratios 21.2, 16.6 and 19.9). The signal head: three 12-inch sections (MUTCD 4D.07; 300 mm lenses, EN 12368 6.2), each housing 13.5 x 13.5 x 7.0 in (SWARCO McCain traffic signal housing sheet), two back to back for the two faces, its bottom 15 ft over the road (MUTCD 4D.15), red on top; each lens a dome 2.0 in proud of its door (Leotek IL6-P3 12-inch module), under a cap visor as deep as the lens is wide, 0.10 in thick (McCain visor sheet), dull black (MUTCD 4D.12). The walkers' head: two 8-inch sections (10 x 10 x 7.0 in, 200 mm lenses, domes 1.7 in, 8-inch visors), the upraised hand above the walking person (MUTCD 4E.04), its bottom at 8.5 ft, the middle of MUTCD 4E.05's 7 to 10 ft. Housings and visors black: linear albedo 0.05, a black-pigmented polymer (Physically Based, 'Toner (Black)'). The lenses are not in the post's mesh: each is drawn once, lit or not, by render/props/signal_lamps.h.

wires._doc: The wires of a span: every course (y_m, under the arm) at every offset across it (z_m, the insulators): nine, as the Roadcraft 4.0 strings them. sag: share of the span, up to max_sag_m. radius_m: thicker than life so a cable reads at play zoom, as the 4.0 draws it. min_span_m, max_span_m: what is strung. near_chords and near_sides are the tube up to tube_end_m, far_chords and far_sides the coarse one up to far_end_m, where a wire is under a pixel at the 1600 x 900 view. Sag and these distances have no norm behind them: measured against the 4.0 in play.

trees._doc: Trees (native/src/render/trees): the models are one unit tall and scaled to their height. Each key's origin is in the _doc of its block: atlas (_doc), species (_species_doc), placement (_doc). What has no published or measured value says so, as a modelling choice. The wind lives in materials.json (vegetation). The street trees stand where data/catalog/street_furniture.json places them.
trees._species_doc: Species models, all keys a share of the tree's height unless said. dark, lit, color and bloom tones: medians measured on the visual-target photos and held as sRGB (green tones scaled until our crowns on screen match the reference crowns' median (33, 72, 43)). shade_bottom 0.43: linear luminance of the lower third over the upper third of a crown, median of 8 crowns measured on registro/vegetacao-terreno/14_lago_perto.jpg (0.27-0.91). jitter 0: no measurement separates a face's random tone from the leaf cards over it, so faces differ only by their normal. palm (Syagrus romanzoffiana, Carvalho, Especies Arboreas Brasileiras vol. 2, Embrapa 2006): arched pinnate leaves up to 5 m long give fronds length 0.38-0.46 of a tree of about 11 m; fronds count 10 is the low end of the 10-25 leaves a crown of field guides; trunk rings 5 are tube sections for the lean; segments 6 keeps the sagitta of a 5 m arc bent 90 degrees under a pixel at 30 m. Modelling choices, no published or measured value, compared by eye with the visual-target photos: trunk top, r0, r1, facets and lean; limbs count, reach, rise and r; crowns center, radius, rough, subdiv, cards, card and taper; heart_shade and heart_shrink; crown_reach; far_width; bloom above; fronds young, rise, droop, young_length, young_rise, young_droop, width and fold. seed: the random stream, no meaning.

atlas._doc: Leaf atlas, drawn once at start (leaf_atlas.cpp). Modelling choices of a procedural texture, compared by eye with the leaf masses of the visual-target photos (registro/vegetacao-terreno/08_parque_dia.jpg); no published or measured value: px (texture side), leaves (leaves per tuft), leaf_len_px and leaf_wid_px (leaf size), spread and squash (tuft shape), heart_bias (leaves toward the tuft's middle), leaf_tone_min, lit_lift, rim and rim_share (leaf tones), leaflets, leaflet_px, leaflet_reach, leaflet_vary, leaflet_rise and leaflet_tilt (frond leaflets), rachis_px, rachis_tone and frond_tone_min (frond midrib and tone), seed (the random stream, no meaning).

placement._doc: Where trees grow (tree_place.cpp, tree_look.cpp). Woods: bands inner and edge by a field of patches mass_m 180 (patches of 100-250 m measured on the visual-target photos), octaves 3 of fractal noise, thresholds set from wood_inner_share and wood_edge_share (crown cover of the open land measured 0.10-0.12 on the far reference view). inner: crown_cover 0.7 and height_m 8-15 (cerradao, cover 50-90 %, Ribeiro & Walter 1998, Cerrado: ambiente e flora, Embrapa; SP Resolucao SMA 64/2009 art. 2 XI: over 8 m). edge: crown_cover 0.5 and height_m 3-6 (cerrado stricto sensu, SMA 64/2009 art. 2 XII: crowns on about 50 % of the ground, 3-6 m). open: height_m 3-8, lone trees within the 10 m the same item rarely passes, open_per_ha 0.5 measured on the visual-target photos. slope_grade 0.2-1.0 (true gradient): from forte ondulado, 20 %, to the 45 degrees of Lei 12.651/2012 art. 4 V; max_grade 0.75: no trees on escarpado relief, over 75 % (Embrapa, Sumula da X Reuniao Tecnica de Levantamento de Solos, 1979); riparian_m 30: art. 4 I a of the same law. jitter 1.0: a candidate anywhere in its cell of grid_m (jittered sampling, Cook 1986, ACM TOG 5(1)). tint_vary 0.15: spread of the median crown luminance over 8 crowns measured on 14_lago_perto.jpg, CV 0.088 times sqrt 3 for a uniform draw. near_m 245: a 12 m tree then spans 42-70 px of 900 at the camera's 55-35 degrees of fov. Sizing and modelling choices, no published or measured value: fade_m, pop_m, far_m, far_cell_m, far_spread, far_jitter, far_shadows, grid_m, slope_gain, riparian_gain, crowd_tall, crowd_narrow, edge_lean, width_vary, min_y_m, road_margin_m, lot_margin_m, park_m2_per_tree, park_edge_m, park_max, park_height_m, street_height_m, and the species shares of mix, park_mix and street_mix (broadleaf, broadleaf_tall, conifer, palm, ipe_yellow, ipe_pink, shrub).

lamp_light._doc: The night light of a lamp: pool on the ground and beam from the lens, as the Roadcraft 4.0 draws them (scenery.ts). lamp_* are the utility pole lens, column_* the lighting column lens in props.pole.

barriers._doc: The barriers drawn (render/props/barrier_boxes.cpp): each run cut into pieces of at most piece_m that step with the ground, sunk sink_m so a slope never shows under them. guard_step_m: NBR 6971 through DER-PR ES-OC 07/18, posts every 2.00 m. The other measures carry no norm and follow the Roadcraft 4.0 look, and so do finishes: colour, metalness and roughness of each material.

signs._doc: The plates (render/props/street_signs.cpp, project/render/sign_sheet.gd). sheet_*, plate_cell_px, square_rows: the sheet of pictures, 16 plates and 32 name plates, sized by what a city uses (the generated map 5, every type once 14; the Roadcraft 4.0 small city 26 street names); a 0.5 m plate gets 256 px per metre, and the camera at its closest (view_half_min 0.8) shows 562 per metre on 900 lines. CONTRAN MBST vol. I (2022) 3.7, recommended for town: stop, R-1, side 0.35 m, 0.845 m across, an octagon; yield, R-2, side 0.90 m; round plates 0.50 m. z_m is the plate centre: 3.11 puts the bottom edge 2.0 to 2.5 m up, here 2.1 m. The round plates, the warnings and the name plates, and the picture of every plate (rims, words, the walker, the arrow), follow the Roadcraft 4.0 look: no norm was read for them. outline_points 0 is a rectangle; turn the first corner, in turns. drawings: the picture of each type, in SignType order, in shares of the plate: rim a colour round the field, inner_share how far the field comes out, word_height and word_width the lettering's height and room, bar, slash and the walker in shares of its radius, arrow its tip, its base and its half height. word_bold: FontVariation.variation_embolden of the lettering.
